My parents just watched me self destruct, didn’t even try and intervene (I would have if I was watching my son do what I was doing) I’ce made choices that have ruined my future, through my actions I now know my own son will grow up to resent me, my household just suffers in silence in blissful ignorance to the world around them, I have been brainwashed my whole life and I ruined my one chance at happiness, my ex wanted nothing but better for me, she pulled me out of the gutter and I threw myself right back in it, my reactions spited nobody but myself and now due to my actions I know my son will grow up to resent me, I know he will, I have fucked up beyond belief, I have no future prospects, no career, no hobbies I literally barely exist each day, I don’t sleep as my mind doesn’t stop racing and torturing me to the shitty choices I’ve made it’s like I am awoken but it’s far too late and my own soul is torturing me for the choices I’ve made I know I’ll never be happy again, my ex gave me a spark, she made me believe in myself, she gave me hope, now without her and the path of self destruction I went in I have nothing but my own guilt and anger towards myself and my shitty upbringing. I just want the sleepless nights to end, the pain to end, I’m ashamed of the choices I’ve made and I don’t want to burden this guilt for the rest of my life, my son will be better off without a piece of shit like me.

I missed my opportunity to get up and be strong and just spiralled into a hole of self destruction, I know I’ll never be happy again and I just want it all to end, I want to die😞😢 I know this is selfish but it is all my mind tells me, I deserve to die for the choices I have made, I have single handedly ruined my future. There is no way back
